remarks: The Key To Your Dream Home is here at this exceptional 2003 custom-built brick front Colonial, perfectly positioned on a picturesque pond-front setting and offering 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and 2,861 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space. Impeccably maintained and loaded with recent mechanical updates, this home blends timeless elegance w/ modern comfort. Step inside the impressive 2Story foyer that welcomes you into a spacious, light-filled floor plan. The elegant formal dining rm showcases crown moldings, wainscoting & the perfect setting for entertaining. A private den/home office features custom built-in cabinetry & double French doors, creating an ideal work-from-home space.The heart of the home is the Chef’s Kitchen, seamlessly open to the oversized sunroom & dramatic 2Story family rm, making entertaining effortless. Enjoy granite countertops, maple cabinetry, SS appliances, a center island w/seating, walk-in pantry, and convenient access to the rear laundry/mudroom with exterior man door leading to the backyard.The stunning sunroom is surrounded by walls of windows overlooking the tranquil pond and opens through a sliding glass door to the stamped concrete patio, creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience for relaxing or entertaining guests.Upstairs, retreat to the spacious Primary Suite featuring a tray ceiling, walk-in closet, and luxurious spa bath complete w/ whirlpool soaking tub, dual vanities & oversized shower. 3 additional generously sized bedrooms offer abundant closet space and share a well-appointed hallway full bath. A built-in hallway office/homework station provides the perfect place for studying or working from home.The expansive lower level offers endless possibilities to finish to your personal taste while providing an incredible amount of storage space.Enjoy peace of mind with outstanding recent improvements including a brand-new furnace (2026), central A/C (2020), dual water heaters (2026), and all new smoke and carbon monoxide detectors (2026).Combining quality craftsmanship, generous living spaces, beautiful pond views & exceptional updates this home is a MUST SEE TO APPRECIATE!
